extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: Dutch tower windmill with stage, octagonal tower approx. 9.8 m wide at the base, cap top 17.9 m, sail span 19 m (hub at 16 m)
extras.notes: exterior only (closed tower, opaque windows, no interior); sails face -Y; the sails (windmill_sails) are a separate object with its origin on the wind shaft axis (hub centre) - rotate around the local Y axis to turn them; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
